description: Maximum floor joist span for dimension lumber from Table 9.23.4.2.-A of the 2024 Ontario Building Code, and whether your clear span is within it. Source: Ontario Building Code 2024, Division B, Table 9.23.4.2.-A, Maximum Spans for Floor Joists, General Cases.

size.description: Joist or rafter size (38 mm thick).

spacing_mm.description: Spacing on centre (12, 16 and 24 in are also accepted). Unit: mm.

span_ft.description: Clear span between the inside faces of the supports in feet (or use span_m). Unit: ft.

span_in.description: Extra inches added to span_ft. Unit: in.

span_m.description: Clear span between the inside faces of the supports in metres, instead of span_ft. Unit: m.

name: floor_joist_span_calculator
title: Floor Joist Span Calculator
